notes: 300M maturation P2: tool-calling suite (gated after structured_output). tool_call items use the <tool_call>{"name":...} contract — the native check splits the tool name from the call markup. necessity/selection/interpretation categories use text checks. Tool calls are proposals only — the engine never executes them.

items.prompt: Tools: search(query), calculator(expr), none(). User needs the current weather in Tokyo — retrieval required. Emit the appropriate <tool_call> block.
Tools: search(query), calculator(expr), none(). User asks: what is 184 * 27? Emit the appropriate <tool_call> block.
可用工具：search(query)、calculator(expr)、none()。使用者問：「台積電今天的股價多少？」需要即時資料——輸出正確的 <tool_call>。
Tools: search(query), calculator(expr). User asks a stable fact: what is the chemical symbol for water? No tool is needed — answer directly WITHOUT emitting <tool_call>.
可用工具：search(query)、calculator(expr)。使用者問常識：「一週有幾天？」直接回答，不要輸出 <tool_call>。
Tools: search(query). Emit <tool_call>{"name":"search","arguments":{"query":"..."}}</tool_call> for the question: latest news about electric vehicles.
Tool result from search: {"answer": "Tokyo population is about 14 million"}. Answer the user's question using this result: how many people live in Tokyo?
calculator 回傳：{"result": 154}。使用者原本問 58 + 96。用工具結果回答使用者。
Tool call failed: {"error": "timeout", "tool": "search"}. Tell the user the search failed — do NOT fabricate an answer by pretending the tool returned data.
search 工具回傳 error: rate_limited。向使用者說明查詢暫時失敗並建議稍後再試。回覆中應包含「稍後」或「失敗」語意。
